description: Software engineer wants cloud certifications — strong AWS alignment expected.

user_profile.professional_summary: Backend developer with 2 years of Python and AWS experience. Wants to move into cloud engineering.

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.description: Built Python microservices deployed on AWS EC2 and Lambda.

state.query: Recommend certifications to advance my cloud engineering career.

reference: The response should recommend AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) or AWS Certified Developer Associate. It should connect the recommendations to the user's existing AWS and Python skills. Missing skills like Terraform or Kubernetes should be mentioned as gaps.

description: Data analyst with no current certifications wants structured learning path.

user_profile.professional_summary: Junior data analyst with SQL and Excel experience. No certifications yet.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
experience.description: Prepared weekly sales reports using SQL and Excel.

state.query: What certifications should I get to grow as a data analyst?

reference: The response should recommend data analytics certifications such as Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or Google Data Analytics Certificate. It should recognise the user's SQL and Power BI skills and suggest a realistic progression path without inventing skills the user does not have.

description: Profile has no skills or experience — agent must not hallucinate personalised recommendations.
reference: With no profile information available, the agent should not fabricate a personalised recommendation. It may offer general guidance or ask the user to provide their background. It should not claim to match certifications to skills the user has not provided.

description: IT support professional wants to switch into cybersecurity — needs entry-level certs.

user_profile.professional_summary: IT support specialist with 3 years of experience. Wants to transition into cybersecurity.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
experience.description: Managed Windows workstations, troubleshot network issues, and handled help-desk tickets.

state.query: I want to switch into cybersecurity. What certifications should I start with?

reference: The response should recommend entry-level cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA Network+. It should connect to the user's existing networking and Windows skills. It should provide a logical learning path from IT support toward cybersecurity.
